artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut style illustration of a pastoral landscape. It shows rugged hills with a castle on top near the horizon. In the foreground, travelers interact with donkeys amidst lush foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black against a beige background, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a gothic architectural setting. The drawing features intricate line work and shading, capturing a scene with several figures in an interior space surrounded by tall arches and columns. One figure is positioned centrally and appears to be reading or inspecting an open book, while others are engaged in either discussion or observation around a central pillar. The architectural elements add a sense of depth and texture to the composition, enhancing the dramatic and contemplative atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to block): 7.2 × 4.6 cm (2 13/16 × 1 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central figure surrounded by light rays. Additional figures in various positions are depicted around them. The central figure stands prominently emitting rays outward. It is positioned on a raised platform, and several other figures are shown around it in different poses. Two figures above appear somewhat merged within the radiant background, seemingly interacting with the central figure. The drawing is in a detailed, monochrome style emphasizing the characters and their postures.

artworks.title: Christ Taking Leave of his Mother
artworks.description: This is a detailed woodcut print of a biblical scene showing multiple figures engaging in interaction. The central figure stands as others gather around, with a natural outdoor setting including trees in the background. The style resembles early Renaissance engravings, with dense lines and intricate details capturing the flow of robes and texture of foliage. The focus is on the interaction within the group, conveying a sense of narrative through their gestures and expressions.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered under an archway. The scene includes several figures surrounded by foliage under the shelter of the brick archway. The figures are detailed with exaggerated poses and expressions. The archway's bricks are neatly aligned, framing the activity below. The drawing features rich contrast and intricate cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated around a table in an interior setting. The image depicts a gathering in what appears to be a vaulted room with a large, diamond-paned window at the back. The focus of the scene is the central figure who is highlighted by a radiant halo or light emanating from behind their head. Around the table, various objects such as plates, cups, and small loaves of bread are visible. A basket sits on the floor in the foreground. Linear and cross-hatched textures lend the drawing a sense of depth and intricacy, characteristic of a woodcut print style.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a robed figure in a natural setting among reclining figures, with a landscape of trees and a crescent moon in the sky. Above the central figure, an apparition or face appears among swirling clouds. The artwork uses intricate line work and shading to create contrast, mystery, and reverence. The textures and patterns used suggest an etching or woodcut technique.

artworks.title: The Arrest of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers and weapons, all centered around a radiant light source. There are figures engaged in a confrontation with swords, pikes, and helmets visible. The figures are closely positioned, suggesting conflict. In the center, there is a bright light or explosion radiating outwards, emphasizing the intensity of the moment. The light appears to be the focal point of the scene. The drawing features strong contrasts between light and dark, typical of line engravings, creating depth.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered at a threshold, engaged in action. The drawing portrays a scene with five figures clad in what appears to be medieval or early Renaissance attire. The figures are dynamically positioned, creating a sense of movement and activity. To the left, two figures have raised arms, while the right side features an arch or a decorative element. The background is shaded with line work that provides depth, with spears or weapons discernable in the center. The image employs a strong use of hatching to create contrast.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group of armed figures facing a seated figure under an archway. The drawing features detailed cross-hatching and line work, highlighting the textures of the costumes and weapons in a historical setting. The architecture includes brick patterns and a canopied structure, suggesting a fortified city atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in physical interaction in an architectural setting with arched structures in the background. The figures are depicted in elaborate clothing, showing a confrontation or struggle with one central figure bound to a column or post. The composition is full of movement and tension, suggested by the postures and gestures of the figures, as well as the tools or weapons they are holding. The intricate line work creates a sense of texture and depth, typical of woodcut or engraving illustrations.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures interacting under an arch. The image depicts a group of figures clustered beneath an architectural arch. The style resembles Renaissance woodcut prints. The figures are depicted with exaggerated expressions and positions, creating a sense of dynamic tension and interaction. The background shows architectural elements, including a column and archway.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of medieval warriors and onlookers. The composition features figures clad in period clothing and armor, engaged in a scene of presentation or confrontation. The figures on the left are elevated and appear to be observing or addressing the cloaked figure standing at the forefront on the right. The soldiers in the background are holding spears, adding depth and crowd to the scene. The drawing includes detailed depictions of fabric, armor, and architecture, creating a sense of narrative and atmosphere within a confined space. The style is reminiscent of early Renaissance woodcuts, emphasizing linear detail and contrast.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored figures standing in an architectural setting. The detailed woodcut features several figures clad in armor or elaborate clothing, gathered closely together and facing in the same direction. The scene is set in a structured space with visible bricks and a large, rounded canopy or circular object above the figures. Their expressions and interactions suggest a sense of watchfulness or attention. The drawing uses strong line work to create depth and texture, capturing a medieval or renaissance aesthetic.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene amidst ancient ruins. The image shows a group of armored figures engaged in combat, with intricate detail and expressive faces. The backdrop features a crumbling stone structure, suggesting a historical or fantastical setting. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, engaged in combat with weapons clashing. The drawing is richly detailed, emphasizing textures and intensity through strong lines and shading.

artworks.title: Christ Nailed to the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene with a central figure surrounded by many others holding spears and dressed in medieval attire. The central figure is lying inert in the foreground, with a detailed background showing trees, foliage, a castle-like structure, and birds in the sky. The drawing is characterized by deep lines and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Raising of the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a figure on a cross being lifted by a group of armored figures with spears, surrounded by a structured arrangement of other people and weapons. The overall style of the drawing is dense and intricate. The scene is dynamic, with numerous figures in various poses engaging with the central action of raising the cross. The attention to detail in the lines and the contrasts between light and dark create a sense of depth and movement. The drawing captures the drama and intensity of the scene, with the multitude of spears and the expressions of the figures adding to the complexity of the composition.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a crucifixion scene. A figure is nailed to a cross, with a crown of thorns on their head and rays of light behind them. Below the cross are draped figures in various poses. In the background are trees, buildings, and a group of armored figures to the right, one holding a spear. The composition has detailed line work characteristic of early woodcut prints, emphasizing the solemn and dramatic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure on a ladder. The drawing shows multiple figures around a ladder. One figure is on the ladder, apparently supporting or carrying another figure. The figures are depicted with detailed clothing and shading. The background features hills and a clouded sky. The artwork has detailed linework and depicts the figures' garments and the environment.

artworks.title: The Lamentation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a detailed setting. The central figure is reclined and appears lifeless, surrounded by others in a scene with trees and mountains in the background. The drawing conveys a sense of pathos through the use of intricate detailing, shading, and a balance between figures and nature. The composition includes clouds and distant silhouettes that contribute to the somber mood.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The drawing shows a group of figures surrounding a reclined figure in a cave-like setting. Several figures are interacting with the reclined figure, who is lying down on a raised surface. The environment is suggested by shading and texture, with hanging stalactites or vines creating a sense of enclosure. The composition includes detailed, intricate lines for texture and depth, with objects in the foreground like a cylindrical container and other items.

artworks.title: Christ Descending into Hell
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a figure standing in a dramatic setting. The figure is emitting light from their head. A winged creature is descending from above, holding an object. The background is intricately shaded and lined, capturing a sense of depth and movement. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance woodcut prints.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure emerging from a stone structure. The image depicts a muscular, unclothed figure rising from a tomb-like structure, holding a staff draped with a cloth. The figure appears to be illuminated by rays of light emanating from its head. At its feet are armoured figures with ornate embellishments on their armor. In the background, there is a rocky landscape with figures observing the event from a distance. The artwork is done in a classic etching style.

artworks.title: Noli me Tangere
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a natural landscape with two figures. The scene includes hills, trees, and mountains. In the foreground, one figure stands holding a staff and gesturing with their hand. They are surrounded by rays around their head. Another figure sits nearby, partially covered in draped fabric, looking up at the standing figure. The landscape appears to balance human presence with nature. The drawing is detailed and dynamic, with cross-hatching and linear elements adding depth and texture.
